text.tspan: Annual Report of the Great Lakes Regional Water Use Database Representing 2023 Water Use Data
Lake Ontario is the easternmost of the Great Lakes
and the smallest in surface area (covering 7,340
square miles or 19,009 square kilometers). It is
extremely deep (802 feet or 244 meters maximum)
and while smaller than Lake Erie in surface area,
it exceeds it in volume by nearly three and a half
times (393 cubic miles or 1,639 cubic kilometers).
St. Lawrence River to the Atlantic Ocean
